The *Samuccayavāra* ("Summary of the previous six sections") constitutes the eighth section of the first division of the *Parivāra* in the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Functioning as an analytical digest, the text concatenates and synthesizes the findings and classifications established in the preceding chapters [SuttaCentral]. It has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali [SuttaCentral].

Computational analysis by DharmaNexus records extensive Pali-internal text reuse, with 462 matching segments across 32 other texts [DharmaNexus]. The closest internal parallels are found within other sections of the *Parivāra*, most prominently the *Antarapeyyāla* (Pvr 4), the *Katthapaññattivāra* (Pvr 1.1), the *Adhikaraṇabheda* (Pvr 11), and other recurring summary sections such as Pvr 1.16, Pvr 2.8, and Pvr 2.16 [DharmaNexus]. Passages also appear in subsequent Vinaya exegesis, including the *Sāratthadīpanī-ṭīkā* and the *Vinayavinicchaya-ṭīkā* [DharmaNexus]. While SuttaCentral records no direct external parallels, DharmaNexus detects low-level formulaic alignments with Tibetan canonical and treatise literature [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
